headline: Mid-bounce off $4.77 low

factors.evidence: Clean HH/HL bull leg $2.72→$7.34. Then a double top at $7.341 (two daily highs tagged identically) and a 3-day breakdown to $4.77 that broke the most recent higher low ($5.04) — but the larger HL ($4.44) and the bull structure remain intact.
Price $5.50 is just below the 20 EMA.
Price above the 50 EMA; 20>50 stack still intact.
Price above the bull-leg AVWAP — the whole up-move's cost basis still holds.
Pulled back from overbought during the rally to the midline; no longer bullish regime, not yet bearish.
The two heaviest recent daily bars (9.6M, 7.9M) were down days; the bounce came on lighter volume (3.5–4.4M). Distribution near-term.

The decline off $7.34 was clean LH/LL. Off the $4.77 low price is now making higher lows ($4.77→$5.01→$5.08) and higher highs ($5.28→$5.43→$5.58) — a short-term up-turn, but the larger 4H lower-high at ~$5.95 is not yet broken.
Price well below the decline's AVWAP; not reclaimed.
Recovering from oversold, now above its signal MA (39.4) and reclaiming the midline. Turning up.
A 2.87M volume spike marked the $4.77 low (exhaustion); the bounce is on lighter, sub-1M bars — not yet demand expansion.

setup.thesis: Long the pullback off the $4.77–5.03 confluence support (0.5–0.618 of the $2.72→$7.34 bull leg + daily 50 EMA $4.83), targeting mean-reversion back into the $5.58–6.0 supply band.
setup.not: It is not a Breakdown (the larger structure held) and not cleanly a Bullish Divergence Reversal (the dominant trend is up, not down — a reversal setup needs a bearish backdrop).

evidence_matrix.reading: Uptrend intact above 50 EMA/cycle AVWAP, but double top $7.34 + broke minor HL $5.04
Heaviest recent bars (9.6M, 7.9M) were down days; bounce lighter
RSI 50.2 rising, above signal MA 39.4, reclaiming midline
$4.77 swept below $5.00 round + $5.04 swing, then reclaimed
Capitulation spike 2.87M at the low then contraction; bounce not volume-confirmed

analyst_summary: INJ's daily uptrend is intact but damaged: price holds above the 50 EMA ($4.83) and cycle-low AVWAP ($4.86) with a 20>50 stack, yet sits below the daily 20 EMA after a ~35% double-top correction off $7.34.

The bounce off the $4.77 capitulation low is a with-daily-trend pullback that is currently countertrend on the 4H and unconfirmed — it has reclaimed the 4H 20 EMA and turned momentum up, but has not reclaimed the dense $5.58–6.0 supply band.
Chasing spot at $5.50 gives sub-1:1 R:R; a disciplined entry waits for a dip into $5.00–5.10 (stop < $4.77) or a 4H close above $5.95–6.0 to confirm continuation.

Notes: BTC was not separately read this pass (the quote tool returns the chart symbol) — INJ is high-beta to BTC and a BTC breakdown would override this long. The whole thesis hinges on the $5.58–6.0 shelf, where the daily 20 EMA, 0.382 fib, 4H 50 EMA, 4H decline AVWAP, and broken support stack into one wall. Daily Predictive Ranges rendered stale/negative lower bands and was excluded; all EMAs/AVWAPs were computed directly from bar data.
bottom_line: An unconfirmed, with-daily-trend pullback bounce that is countertrend on the 4H — treat as a tactical dip-buy ($5.00–5.10) or wait for a 4H reclaim of $5.95–6.0, not a chase at spot.

failure_scenario: Bounce stalls into the $5.58–6.0 supply/EMA/AVWAP band, gets rejected, the neutral bias resolves downward, and price makes a lower low below $4.77 toward the $4.49 (0.618) / $4.44 daily demand and the $4.83 50 EMA.
conclusion: Pullback / Mean-Reversion Bounce — with the daily trend but countertrend on the 4H and unconfirmed as continuation; explicitly not a confirmed trend-following entry.
